title: What Is It?
content: This welded sculpture, called "What is It?" is by a blacksmith named Lincoln in Campbell, Missouri.Mr. Lincoln collected iron knick-knacks for over 35 years, welded them together, painted them black, and placed the sculpture prominently on his front lawn.Among the objects are a clothesline wheel, horse bit, chain, bas relief of Abe Lincoln, cowbell, clothes iron, sickle, pulley, awl, hammer, pliers, horseshoes, railroad spikes, and hat hooks.17h
